newsitem.title: PERU: Peru details distribution of Luz del Sur shrs.
newsitem.headline: Peru details distribution of Luz del Sur shrs.

text.p: Peruvian privatization officials said Wednesday they had awarded 60 percent of their offer of shares in Luz del Sur to individual nationals.

Javier Tovar, head of the privatization committee overseeing the sale to individual Peruvian investors, said 23.5 percent of the shares were allocated to local institutions and 13.5 percent to foreign institutions.
The remaining three percent of shares were held for bonus payments, Tovar said.
"We have had extremely high demand and we are very happy with the results," he said.
The government is selling its 30 percent stake in Luz del Sur, equivalent to 148.4 million shares, at 3.10 soles per share.
